question.text:
Q. An 8-to-1 multiplexer has its select lines $S_2, S_1, S_0$ connected to $A, B, C$ respectively. The data inputs are as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned}
& I_1=I_2=I_7=0 \\
& I_3=I_5=1 \\
& I_0=I_4=D \\
& I_6=D^{\prime}
\end{aligned}
$$


Which Boolean function of $A, B, C, D$ is implemented by the multiplexer?

  1. $F=A^{\prime} B^{\prime} C^{\prime} D+A^{\prime} B C+A B^{\prime} C^{\prime} D+A B^{\prime} C+A B C^{\prime} D^{\prime}$
     
  2. $F=A^{\prime} B^{\prime} C^{\prime} D+A^{\prime} B C+A B^{\prime} C^{\prime} D^{\prime}+A B^{\prime} C+A B C^{\prime} D^{\prime}$
     
  3. $F=A^{\prime} B^{\prime} C^{\prime} D+A^{\prime} B C+A B^{\prime} C^{\prime} D+A B^{\prime} C+A B C D^{\prime}$
     
  4. $F=A^{\prime} B^{\prime} C^{\prime} D+A^{\prime} B C+A B^{\prime} C^{\prime} D+A B C+A B C^{\prime} D^{\prime}$
question.subject: Digital Logic

question.text:

F(x, y, z)=\prod(2,4,5,7)
$$


Which of the following correctly represent the complement $F^{\prime}(x, y, z)$ ?

  1. $\sum(2,4,5,7)$
     
  2. $\sum(0,1,3,6)$
     
  3. $\prod(0,1,3,6)$
     
  4. $\prod(2,4,5,7)$
